audit_items.proof_trace: The code faithfully implements the spec-documented three-segment piecewise linear formula: each branch computes weight-and-range interpolation that exactly matches the spec pseudocode. Continuity at both kink boundaries is algebraically guaranteed (at mid_kink both adjacent segments evaluate to borrow_rate_on_mid_kink; at high_kink both evaluate to borrow_rate_on_high_kink). All intermediate subtractions and divisions are safe because create_interest_model (the sole production constructor) asserts mid_kink>0, mid_kink<high_kink<10000, and base≤mid_rate≤high_rate≤max_rate.
